name: Cail Station
description: An abandoned station evacuated twenty years earlier, where a corruption wound in the Weft is found.

timeline.summary: Ghan weftwalks into the abandoned Cail Station and feels the wrongness within.
timeline.quote: The moment Ghan's seam-ripper parted space, cutting a radiant blue line from the void into the station's dark, debris-strewn arcade, he felt the change.

timeline.summary: The archives reveal the botched Cail Station evacuation that left Errit dead.
timeline.quote: the botched evacuation of Cail Station that had prioritized the retrieval of expensive, specialized mining equipment over the lives of its residents.
